name: src
description: URL of the SVG file to load and inline.

name: title
description: Title to set on the SVG, replaces an existing one.

name: uniqueIds
description:
Rewrites all IDs inside the SVG to be unique per instance. Only needed for SVGs that
reference IDs internally, e.g. via gradients or clip paths.

name: transformSource
description:
Function to modify the SVG element before it gets rendered. Receives the already
sanitized element and has to return it.
